summary: A 15-year-old girl fell into the St. Vrain River in the Wild Basin area and was carried about 50 yards downstream, over an eight-foot waterfall and through rapids, before bystanders and family pulled her out ahead of rangers. She suffered leg injuries and was carried on a wheeled litter to the Wild Basin trailhead, then taken by ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center.
location: St. Vrain River, Wild Basin area
